speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Keep to your half of the mat. The stone is damp, and the board is behind you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have lost the head he is on.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then sit. Sir John is in his pew. He is not your text, and he is not looking.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Stay for the prayer. Take home what you can carry. I will not write it on a paper for you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have come because it is Sunday. Nothing from the sermon. The jaw is what I can repeat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then you have learned nothing, and you may say so at dinner without dressing it. Home. I am not stopping in the lane.
